# `gcp.keyring`

A `KeyRing` is a toplevel logical grouping of `CryptoKeys`. ~> **Note:** KeyRings cannot be deleted from Google Cloud Platform. Destroying a Terraform-managed KeyRing will remove it from state but *will not delete the resource from the project.*
